newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BA INJURED, LIKELY TO MISS FRENCH CUP MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BA INJURED, LIKELY TO MISS FRENCH CUP MATCH.

text.p: Bordeaux's Ibrahim Ba is nursing a thigh injury picked up playing for France in their 2-1 win over the Netherlands and will probably miss their French Cup tie against Cannes on Saturday.
The League Cup finalists' coach Rolland Courbis said on Thursday Ba, substituted in the 78th minute of Wednesday's international, had one chance in 10 of playing in the third round match at Bordeaux.
